structured.answer: This page doesn't let me pick a broker. It's a list of companies with fee-schedule dates and no actual fees, so I'd have to click into a bank or the "לפי מוצר" tab to get a number I can compare.

Each row shows 'תעריפון מ־' and a date, but no fee. I couldn't tell whether the numbers sit behind the arrow.

'בנקים ובתי השקעות נוספים' with the 'תעריפון מ־' dates

findings.what: No fee numbers anywhere on the page. It's a directory, not a comparison.
Banks show only the date of their fee schedule, not its contents
Investment houses and banks are listed differently (product tags vs fee-schedule date), so you can't compare across the two sections
The orange 'ללא תאריך פרסום' isn't explained
The 'not commercial, no affiliate links' line is buried in the footer, though it's a plus
